about_the_game:
Continue the story of the DNA Universe...

During the battle between Terror Terius and OMNI Leo and the Death of Chairman Sujo... his heir Nol Sujo immediately took control of Nova Corp and was determined in building the Nova Corp army by any means necessary. He focused on the DNA extraterrestrial experiments and the Artificial Intelligence divisions. Most were failed experiments but there were a few that were successful to lead the Nova Corp Army but there was one Nol Sujo was not able to control.. Thus the DNA Story... continues

The DNA Story Continues...

  • Continuing the story of DNA 1 as a episodic in game Anime where you play as Inoa in DNA 2.

     



  • Now that Nole Sujo has taken over as Chairman of Nova Corp. Nole has much sinister ambitious plans to take over the world and is determined not to fail like his father Chairman Sujo did.





  • Leo has finally transformed into Omni Leo and has defeated Terius. Or so we think... 

Epic upgraded DNA Gameplay...

DNA 1 created by a solo developer in retro 2d world, now has made major upgrades in DNA 2 in a 3D open world.



  • Gameplay of DNA 2 is a open world Action RPG, as you play as Inoa you will have the ability to unlock new moves from Hand to Hand, Energy and Sword combat moves on the ground and in the air! 

  • As you travel the massive new DNA 2 World you will have the ability to travel in the air and on the ground with vehicles and horses. 

  • Search and earn "Inoa Coin" crypto as you travel the new DNA World and defeat enemies. 

DNA 2 a world like no other...

  • As you explore fully interact with DNA 2 enviroments and find secrets hidden to mankind.

  • Witness an Anime experience like no other during gameplay.

  • Be one with Inoa and find out what happens in the next episode of DNA 2: Episode 1!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (ver. 2004 or later)
  • Processor: AMD FX-8350 / Intel® Core™ i5-3330
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 480 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 780 / 3GB VRAM required
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 GB available space

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
